scope: Local no-edge resource reservation prerequisite only; not full protocol admission or an implemented node operation.
working_tree: Preserves pre-existing foundation changes, predicate slice and verification relocation. Source hashes identify evaluated content.

profile.instance_resource_quota: Fixed positive bytes supplied once at pool initialization; enforced by each lifetime ledger.
profile.total_variable_resource_quota: Supplied once at initialization; zero disables acceptance.
profile.qualification: Provisional fixed storage plus separate runtime byte budget; no workload capacity claim.

design_comparison: Separate stable instance slots from operation/report retention; two tables avoid a third report pool while permitting node release with retained duplicate/report state. Compared with combined all-lifetime slots and three separate pools.

host_foundations.result: 1/1 tests passed; seven unchanged foundation groups with ASan/UBSan/LeakSanitizer.

standalone_sanitizer_checks.schedule: Explicit lifecycle barriers and two POSIX threads synchronized at a barrier then serialized by the required caller mutex. Race winner is intentionally unspecified.
cases: Last byte/report capacity and same-ID contention; exactly one accepted contender.
Changed invalid allowance discarded for retained IDs without changing deadlines or state.
Open owner, active access, unaccepted completion and unreleased allocation each block node release.
Node release keeps report capacity occupied; forgetting cannot retire a live node record.
Same physical node slot reused with preserved access tickets; stale callbacks cannot complete new work.
SIZE_MAX byte accounting; zero/MAX IDs; strict deadline boundary and overflow; exhausted lifetime tickets.
Explicit forgotten-history readmission characterizes Q05, not stronger no-resurrection conformance.

independent_state_oracle.algorithm: Independent ownership/retention map checked against the actual C library; compares transitions and global accounting after each decision.
independent_state_oracle.retirement_policy: The oracle supplies the documented upstream Q06 eligibility precondition; it does not validate a storage-ACK policy.

esp32.result: Shared component compiled and foundation firmware linked; no hardware execution.
esp32.measurement: Same ESP-IDF compile flags plus -fstack-usage; static layout measured from sizeof-sized symbols. Stack numbers are compiler frame estimates, excluding callees, not measured task high-water use.
esp32.limitation: Unchanged foundation fixture does not call the new API; component compilation/linking does not establish target admission behavior.

test_preservation: 25 existing test/model/ESP fixture files matched pre-turn hashes. No repository test or model file added or changed.
sandbox_note: Approved sanitizer runs outside the sandbox avoided LeakSanitizer process-tracing incompatibility.
observation: Injected local integer timestamps; no clock reads, network traffic, actual runtime allocations, or protocol outcomes. State invariants observed directly with no telemetry-loss channel.
limits: Authority, full request/schema validation, complete empty incidence/fencing and report/revision qualification remain upstream/pending before managed-work integration.
Reserved report bytes are storage only, not a self-contained result or wire schema.
Conservative retention prevents forgetting an operation record while its node is live; ACK/pressure-eviction policy and independent live-node report retirement remain pending.
Node release enforces tracked resources/completions; external service associations remain caller obligations.
Temporary check sources are not registered repository regression tests and /tmp is not durable storage.
Hardware workload qualification and final Q14 formal verification remain pending.
